title: How the liver processes nutrients and supports the body
intro: The liver processes nutrients, makes important proteins and bile, and changes many medicines and waste substances. It is not a filter that can be reset by a cleansing drink. Different liver problems affect different functions.

sections.heading: Blood and processing
paragraphs: Blood from digestive organs brings absorbed substances through the portal vein; an artery also supplies oxygen. Liver cells process, store or release substances according to the body's needs.

sections.heading: Energy storage
paragraphs: The liver stores glucose as glycogen and releases glucose when needed. It also handles fats and proteins. This regulation works with hormones rather than being controlled by one particular food.

sections.heading: Making and removing
paragraphs: The liver makes albumin and many clotting proteins, and produces bile for digestion and waste removal. The gallbladder stores bile; these organs are connected but not interchangeable.

sections.heading: Protection
paragraphs: Avoid excess alcohol and check medicine and supplement safety with a professional. Too much paracetamol can be dangerous even before symptoms; suspected overdose needs immediate advice. Do not stop prescribed treatment without guidance.

sections.heading: Assessment
paragraphs: Blood tests and imaging assess different features; absence of pain does not exclude disease. New jaundice needs assessment; vomiting blood, black tarry stool, severe confusion or collapse requires urgent help.

A diagram explains typical structure, not the cause of an individual symptom. Before a consultation, note when a change began, what brings it on and how it affects daily activities. Bring previous results and ask how the findings fit together.

examples.title: A practical example
examples.text: In this hypothetical example, Mira asks whether a detox supplement repairs liver injury. She discusses the cause and checks safety instead of assuming natural means harmless.

examples.title: Another practical example
examples.text: In this hypothetical example, Arben accidentally takes overlapping medicines containing paracetamol. He seeks immediate advice rather than waiting for liver pain.
